x: Marshall, our new Army member, Morris won from Kemp and Coleman in a new championship best of 50.3s. This was followed by the Junior which was won by Coxall in 52.8s just outside the record.
Coxall took 2nd place in the 440 and Dabbs won the mile in 4.42. Chamberlain was 2nd in the Long Jump with 19ft. 1½inches only losing by ½ an inch.
